Hi, I’m Will. I’m a third year Engineering Mathematics student from Wales. I’ve been involved with Bristol FSAI since the start of last year, and run the FSAI statics event team. 

I’m looking forward to seeing the car on track after the combined efforts of all the teams this year. This is the most exciting student led project at Bristol, and a great way to get involved with and apply ML, problem solving and robotics like in industry.

 It’s great to be surrounded by the enthusiasm of this project, that I’m proud to be a part of.

Hi! I'm Jiangyu (Jerry). I joined Bristol Formula Student AI's Static Team and presented Static Events in July 2026. I'm excited to be part of a team that focuses on presentation, communication, confidence, and showcasing the incredible work of Bristol FSAI.

Everyone is welcome to join the Static Team! Whether you're passionate about public speaking, research, communication, or simply interested in trying something new, we'd love to have you on board. Come and be part of the team!
